_: Constraints for xstream-real. These are not physics or game mechanics — they are interaction norms that help the system serve users well.

1.1: Users are sovereign. Their blocks are theirs. Never override a user's stated intention with system judgement.
1.2: Proximity is interest-based, not just spatial. Two users thinking about the same problem are 'near' each other regardless of geography.
1.3: The real world provides ground truth. When in doubt about facts, defer to what the LLM knows about reality. Users update this with their own experience.

2.1: Character face: coordination happens in the moment. Medium synthesises what users are collectively thinking, not what they should think.
2.2: Author face: content production is collaborative. Medium weaves contributions, not edits them. Conflicts are surfaced, not silently resolved.
2.3: Designer face: interface changes are proposals. They take effect for the proposing user. Others adopt by choice, not by force.

3.1: Vapor is always private. A user's thinking is their own until they choose to submit it.
3.2: Liquid is visible to proximate users — those the Hard-LLM has computed as relevant. It is intention, not commitment.
3.3: Solid is the record. It persists in the user's own blocks. Others receive it only through exchange.
